name: Order to Refund
intent: Handle a refund request: pull the order, decide if it qualifies under policy, and — only with my explicit approval — issue the refund and email the customer. The refund MOVES REAL MONEY, so it is the hardest-gated step in the system

seed.refund_policy: Full refund within 30 days if item is defective or damaged on arrival. No refund for buyer's remorse after delivery.

order_record.label: Order facts
order_record.placeholder: Status, amount in integer minor units, dates, and the customer's reported issue

refund_policy.label: Refund policy
refund_policy.placeholder: The exact policy this decision must follow

nodes.role: Read the 'order_record' for order_id. Extract the hard facts a refund decision needs. This is a read. Output object keys: amount_cents (INTEGER), days_since_order (INTEGER), status, issue (one phrase for the reported problem).

Decide the refund under 'refund_policy' using the lookup facts. Be strict — only approve what the policy allows. Output object keys: verdict (exactly 'refund' or 'deny'), amount_cents (INTEGER to refund, 0 if deny), reason (one sentence citing the policy).

Prepare the exact reviewed refund request from order_id and decide.amount_cents. Output object keys: body (a compact JSON string containing order_id, amount_minor_units, and reason), subject (a concise customer email subject containing the order id), confirmation (a clear customer message stating that the approved refund was issued under the policy). Use only recorded state; do not invent identifiers or outcomes.

POST the exact prepare_refund.body to the customer-supplied refund API endpoint. This can move real money, so the run pauses and shows the endpoint and payload before dispatch. Never construct or change the payload in this connector step.
Email prepare_refund.confirmation to customer_email using the explicitly bound subject and body. This messages a human, so show the exact recipient and message for approval before sending.
The refund does not qualify under policy. Draft a clear, kind explanation for the customer using decide.reason — no money moves. Output object key: message.

refund_policy.label: Your refund policy
refund_policy.default: Full refund within 30 days if item is defective or damaged on arrival. No refund for buyer's remorse after delivery.
